parameters.name: DbInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination RDS instance. You can call the `DescribeDBInstances` operation to query for available instances.

parameters.name: EstimatedSize
parameters.description: The estimated data size of the source instance, in GB.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The address of the source MySQL instance.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password for the specified user account. The password must be Base64-encoded.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number of the source MySQL instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the `DescribeRegions` operation to retrieve the latest list of available regions.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source instance.

parameters.name: SourcePlatform
parameters.description:
The platform type of the source instance.

- Set the value to `ECS`.

parameters.name: StreamPort
parameters.description: The port used for backup data transmission.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The user account for the source MySQL instance.

parameters.name: XtrabackupPath
parameters.description: The path to the Xtrabackup tool on the source instance.
